I’ll commit to 18 tons this month provided Kate and Jack explicitly agree too. That makes our total 90 tons and leaves 10; I understand there’s still a one-in-four chance we start next month with only 20 tons.

If that happens, I’ll support 3 tons each. Let’s treat this as a one-month agreement, not a standing 18-ton quota—we should set catches based on the stock actually available. Kate, are you willing to join?
